units: <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 3:8">Tosef. Ab. Zar. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 4:8">IV</cite>), 8 <he>בצ׳ הראשון</he> of the first pair (of T’fillin); <cite ref="Eruvin 97a:15">Erub. 97ᵃ</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>צְבָתִים</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 10:1">Ib. X, 1</cite> <he>מצאן צ׳</he> if he found the T’fillin arranged in sets; expl.

<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 10:9">Men. X, 9</cite> (<cite ref="Menachot 71a:8">71ᵃ</cite>) <he>מניחן צ׳</he> (Talm. ed. <he>צְבוּתִים</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 3; Ms. M. <cite ref="R00067"><he>צבצין</he></cite>, corr. acc.) he puts the sheaves down in sets (without tying them). Tosef. Ab. Zar. l. c.
